---
title: "Data loader"
---

The data loading step ensures all possbile ways of passing raw data are coerced into in-memory SpikeInterface objects.

It should exist as a modular convenience function rather than as a fixed step in the pipeline, as its output may be passed to any of [raw data metrics](pipeline-steps.qmd#raw-data-quality-metrics), [artefact detection](pipeline-steps.qmd#artifact-detection), [artefact curation](pipeline-steps.qmd#artifact-curation), [preprocessing](pipeline-steps.qmd#preprocessing), or the [full pipeline](index.qmd#pipeline-steps).
As such, no information related to data loading (e.g. file paths) is encoded in the [`CONFIG`](outputs.qmd#config).

**INPUTS:**

- A [`RAW_DATA_PATH`](outputs.qmd#raw-data-path) or [`RAW_DATA_PATH_SESSION_LIST`](outputs.qmd#raw-data-path-session-list)
- A [`SPIKEINTERFACE_REC`](outputs.qmd#spikeinterface-rec) or [`SPIKEINTERFACE_REC_SESSION_LIST`](outputs.qmd#spikeinterface-rec-session-list).
- (optional) a `bool` flag for producing a `DEBUGGING_REC`
- (optional) a `STREAM_NAME` in case the AP stream cannot be automatically detected.

**OUTPUTS:**

- a [`SPIKEINTERFACE_REC`](outputs.qmd#spikeinterface-rec) or [`SPIKEINTERFACE_REC_SESSION_LIST`](outputs.qmd#spikeinterface-rec-session-list).  
or [`DEBUGGING_REC`](outputs.qmd#debugging-rec) or [`DEBUGGING_REC_LIST`](outputs.qmd#debugging-rec).
- [`CONCAT_REC_TIMES`](outputs.qmd#concat-rec-times) or [`CONCAT_REC_TIMES_LIST`](outputs.qmd#concat-rec-times) if concatenated recordings are detected.

**OPERATIONS:**

- Load a [`RAW_DATA_PATH`](outputs.qmd#raw-data-path) or [`RAW_DATA_PATH_SESSION_LIST`](outputs.qmd#raw-data-path-session-list) to [`SPIKEINTERFACE_REC`](outputs.qmd#spikeinterface-rec) or [`SPIKEINTERFACE_REC_SESSION_LIST`](outputs.qmd#spikeinterface-rec-session-list), respectively.  
- Automatically determine the AP stream, otherwise use `STREAM_NAME`. 
- (optional) time slice the recordings to produce a [`DEBUGGING_REC`](outputs.qmd#debugging-rec).

**CHECKS:**

- ERROR if no probe found in the loaded or passed recordings.
- ERROR if cannot determine AP stream and no `STREAM_NAME` provided.
